cache_layer.mutation_invalidation: non-GET requests clear successful memory cache and advance cacheGeneration

covered_get_paths.note: read-only cache only; login still uses /auth/login and clears cache

derived_provider_cache.purpose: cache filtered adapter metadata derived from shared capability bootstrap state
